explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/377: EGRS 'also prove that, for all large n, f(n) ≤ c log log n for some constant c < 1'. The Lean statement: ∃ c < 1, ∀ᶠ n, f(n) ≤ c·log(log n). Since f ≥ 0 and is not eventually 0, any witness c is positive, so allowing arbitrary c < 1 does not weaken or trivialise the statement. Faithful.
